method: Exploratory paired-seat study. positional=distance heuristic, search=beam-8 two-ply heuristic; positional/search remember repeated states, neither is exact minimax. Capped games are not draws.

summary.caveat: Exploratory policy-specific inference. Bootstrap clusters base layouts; Wilson assumes independent games and is descriptive only. Capped times are censored; no human timing.
